name: dshd-health
description: Deepartments system-health domain (the dshd-health phase of the modular Cordis split): the W6 post-error capture + unusable-session markers, heartbeat/alerts ledger + audit, W8-i error class, M3 interrupt back-off + materialization quarantine, the W8-c safeguards (turn-error capture, stale-live watchdog, preset audit), the W8-d system heartbeat (wait scan, inbox reader, heartbeat section), the W8-h interrupted-post reconciliation, and the C6 delivery-row tail-reader factory + scans + the pure health daemon tick — extracted verbatim from the dsh-deepartments bundle. P1 (modularization, 2026-08-29): the package is NOW ALSO a Cordis PLUGIN (thin name/inject/apply + its own cordis.patch.yml row) providing the `deepartments.health` service (the daemon tick; the ALERT delivery resolves from the EXISTING binder buckets wakepack.messagesStoreReady + deliver.deliverHost, the closure-bound scan inputs arrive via the `health` bucket — DECOUPLING); the bundle still consumes it through the drop-in bridge src/core/health.ts. The ONLY state is the per-process byte-offset cursor inside each createDeliveryRowsTailReader closure (created by the bundle wiring once per daemon — C6 twin-safe), everything else is stateless (ledgers on-disk). Depends on dshd-core (workspace:*) for messages/registry/wakepack machinery; the tick's config is a structural HealthConfigLike (no back-dependency on the bundle's org.ts).
